top_signals.title: Oil Prices No Longer Follow Headlines
top_signals.summary: A month ago, a series of news reports said oil flows out of Hormuz had recovered to pre-war levels, pushing oil prices lower. However, the rout did not last. Benchmarks are set for their fourth monthly gain in a row, and no amount of repeating that Gulf states are exporting even more oil than before the war can change that. Because barrels are not the whole story. “What is the price of oil? top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall as AI Fears Deepen, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks fell, following Friday’s losses on Wall Street, as concern that a rally in artificial intelligence has gone too far spurred a selloff in tech shares. Oil declined.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. Labs Look to New Materials to Close China's Nuclear Lead
top_signals.summary: The United States is racing to reestablish itself as a frontrunner in the global nuclear energy sector. While the country still maintains its status as the world’s largest nuclear power producer, it likely won’t be able to hold onto that accolade for long. China has vastly outspent the United States on nuclear power research and development for years now.
